findings.current: The man looked to be in his nineties, hardly able to move without an Awakening—maybe even a stimulant—but there was no age limit on America’s venerable martial art of gunmanship.
findings.defect: The draft suggests an Awakening might get the doctor moving. The source says he looks far from Awakened and would need a stimulant just to move. “Gunmanship” also loses the mock martial-art name.
findings.rationale: 각성은커녕 contrasts being Awakened with needing 각성제, while 건법(Gun法) presents shooting as a martial art.
findings.replacement: The man looked to be in his nineties and, far from being Awakened, seemed to need a shot of stimulants just to move. But America’s venerable martial art of gun-fu had no age limit.
findings.source: 한눈에 보기에도 각성은커녕 각성제라도 맞아야 움직일 수 있을 것 같은 90대 노인이었으나, 아메리카의 유구한 전통 무술인 건법(Gun法)에는 별다른 나이 제한도 없으니까.
